paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.81% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+2.11%) and Nasdaq weakest (-0.62%). Brent crude changed -3.13% to 91.65. Gold changed +3.83% to 3,671.2. Bitcoin changed +1.41% to 61,350.4805. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.902%, a relative move of +1.11%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (+4.70%) and Glencore (+4.47%) moved the most.
